A '''plasma drill''' was a type of tool.

The [[Byblos Drive Yards/Legends|Byblos Drive Yards]] [[E-2 Asteroid Miner]] ''[[Marauder Starjacker]]'' utilized plasma drills as weapons with modified [[prismatic drill crystal]]s for longer range.<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>
